answer: Funding-tree clustering: validators trace every identity's first 3 incoming transfers back up to 4 hops and group accounts sharing a common funder as one family. A family's rewards are split by 1/sqrt(size), so the 10th fake from one wallet earns only 32% of a unit, and each extra identity adds gas yet shrinks everyone's share. Like a vine tracing back to one root, or pigment spreading from a single source into an oasis, the public transfer graph lets any validator recompute a family.
